description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) called LeavePeriod, representing a period with start and end dates within the OrangeHRM leave management plugin. It includes properties for start and end dates, getter and setter methods, and utilizes a trait for date formatting.

classes.name: LeavePeriod
classes.description: A data transfer object for representing a leave period with start and end dates, providing methods to access and format these dates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a LeavePeriod instance with optional start and end DateTime objects.

methods.name: getYmdStartDate
methods.description: Returns the start date formatted as a string in YMD format.

methods.name: getYmdEndDate
methods.description: Returns the end date formatted as a string in YMD format.
